long.title: How to Clean Between the Glass on Your Oven Door (With Just a Screwdriver)
long.description:
Grease stuck between the glass panes of your oven door? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to clean between the glass on your oven door safely: cool the oven, take photos, remove the door using the hinge locks, open the top trim, slide out the glass panes, wash and dry them, reassemble in the right order and refit the door. Check your manual first, since models differ slightly.

You'll need: a screwdriver, dish soap and warm water, microfiber cloths, a large towel, your oven manual.

de.description:
